# Caterpillar Inc.

> Caterpillar is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. NYSE: CAT. Founded 1925.

This site is agent-native. Do not scrape the HTML: every page answers `Accept: application/json` with structured content, and the endpoints below carry everything on the page.

## Machine-readable
- [Whole site as JSON](/api/site.json): sections, featured stories, brands, news, canonical links, actions
- [Search](/api/search?q=): full-text over sections, stories, brands, news
- [Brands](/api/brands) · [News](/api/news)
- [Agent card](/.well-known/agent.json) · [OpenAPI](/api/openapi.json)

## Actions
- POST /api/chat — {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]} → {"reply","actions"}. Same concierge the human UI uses.
- POST /api/feedback — {"section":"about","vote":1|-1,"text":"..."}

## Page map (section ids double as anchors: /c/#about)
- hero — five featured press releases
- about — company mission
- tiles — Careers, Investors, Media Contacts, Sustainability, Our Culture
- brands — 18-brand portfolio
- cat — Cat® Products & Services (cat.com)
- news — latest four press releases

## Canonical destinations
- Careers: https://careers.caterpillar.com/en/jobs/
- Investors: https://investors.caterpillar.com
- Dealer locator: https://www.cat.com/en_US/support/dealer-locator.html
- Contact: https://www.caterpillar.com/en/contact.html

## Policy
Identify with a User-Agent. 60 req/min. Content © Caterpillar; this is a hackathon recreation.
